chunks.head: burst into tears
chunks.gloss: 突然大哭起来；放声痛哭
chunks.note: burst into + 名词，表示突然爆发出某种情绪或声音，如 burst into tears / laughter / song。
chunks.ex_en: The little girl burst into tears when she lost her toy.
chunks.ex_cn: 小女孩弄丢玩具时突然大哭起来。

chunks.head: can't help it
chunks.note: can't help + it 或 + 动名词，表示情不自禁、无法克制。
chunks.ex_en: The joke was so funny that I couldn't help it and laughed out loud.
chunks.ex_cn: 那个笑话太好笑了，我忍不住笑出了声。

chunks.head: run away
chunks.note: 指逃离、跑开，也可指离家出走。
chunks.ex_en: The frightened cat ran away and hid under the bed.
chunks.ex_cn: 受惊的猫跑开了，躲到床底下。

chunks.head: fall to doing
chunks.note: fall to + 动名词，表示着手、开始(尤指突然)做某事。
chunks.ex_en: As soon as he sat down, he fell to eating hungrily.
chunks.ex_cn: 他一坐下就狼吞虎咽地吃起来。

chunks.head: from head to foot
chunks.note: 表示“整个身体、浑身”。本章作 from head to heel(heel=脚跟)，为同义变体。
chunks.ex_en: He was covered in mud from head to foot.

chunks.head: get away
chunks.note: 指逃脱、跑开，尤指从被抓或困境中脱身。
chunks.ex_en: The thief tried to get away, but the police caught him.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷想逃走，却被警察抓住了。

chunks.head: fall apart
chunks.gloss: 散开；散架；(计划/情绪)崩溃
chunks.note: 本章指人群向两边“散开、闪开”。也常喻指物体散架，或计划、情绪崩溃。
chunks.ex_en: The old book fell apart as soon as I opened it.
chunks.ex_cn: 那本旧书我一打开就散架了。

chunks.head: take the lead
chunks.note: 指率先行动、起带头作用；也指在竞争中处于领先。
chunks.ex_en: Nobody wanted to speak first, so she took the lead.
chunks.ex_cn: 没人愿意先开口，于是她带了头。

chunks.head: wear off
chunks.gloss: (效果/感觉)逐渐消退；渐渐消失
chunks.note: 指药效、疼痛、情绪等慢慢减弱直至消失。

literal.note_cn: 非“穿”义，wear off = 渐渐消失

chunks.ex_en: The pain in my leg slowly wore off after a few days.
chunks.ex_cn: 几天后，我腿上的疼痛渐渐消退了。

chunks.head: keep something to oneself
chunks.gloss: 把(某事)藏在心里；不告诉别人
chunks.note: 指对某消息或看法守口如瓶，不与人分享。
chunks.ex_en: She knew the secret but kept it to herself.
chunks.ex_cn: 她知道那个秘密，却藏在心里没说出去。

chunks.head: get hold of
chunks.note: 指设法拿到、获得某物，或联系上某人。
chunks.ex_en: I finally got hold of the book I'd been looking for.
chunks.ex_cn: 我终于弄到了那本一直在找的书。

chunks.head: catch a glimpse of
chunks.note: glimpse 指短暂的一瞥；本章作 get a glimpse of，同义。
chunks.ex_en: I caught a glimpse of the singer as her car drove past.
chunks.ex_cn: 歌手的车开过时，我瞥见了她一眼。

chunks.head: go out of vogue
chunks.note: vogue 意为“流行、时尚”；go/be out of vogue 指某事物不再时兴。反义为 in vogue。
chunks.ex_en: Wide ties went out of vogue many years ago.
chunks.ex_cn: 宽领带很多年前就不流行了。

chunks.head: reel off
chunks.gloss: 一口气说出；流利地背出/列举
chunks.note: 指毫不费力、连续不断地说出一串话、数字或名单。
chunks.ex_en: She reeled off the names of all fifty states without stopping.
chunks.ex_cn: 她一口气说出了全部五十个州的名字。

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: 主要义为“立即、马上”(本章 1746);也可表“同时、一齐”(本章 1755)。
chunks.ex_en: Come here at once—dinner is getting cold!

chunks.head: take one's eyes off
chunks.gloss: 把目光从…移开；不再盯着看
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(take their fascinated eyes from),故 card-only。常用 can't take one's eyes off = 目不转睛。
chunks.ex_en: The view was so beautiful I couldn't take my eyes off it.
chunks.ex_cn: 那景色太美了，我目不转睛。

chunks.head: make out
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(make anything out of),故 card-only。make out = 理解、辨认;make sth out of = 从…中弄明白。
chunks.ex_en: It was so dark I could barely make out the road.
chunks.ex_cn: 天太黑，我几乎看不清路。
